<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The provided Python script `extract-uuyc-eula.py` is designed to parse, validate, and transform an HTML version of the "网易UU远程软件许可及服务协议" (NetEase UU Remote Software License and Service Agreement) into sanitized plain text and a static HTML document. It performs strict validation of HTML tags and attributes, allowing only a predefined set of tags (`br`, `p`, `span`, `strong`) and restricting `span` elements to specific style properties (`font-family`, `font-size`). Any deviation raises a `ValueError`, ensuring only expected content is processed.

The script computes a SHA-256 hash of the normalized (canonical) content and compares it against an expected value provided as a command-line argument. This serves as a semantic checksum to verify content integrity without relying on file-level hashes. It does not perform any network operations, execute external code, or access sensitive system resources.
